title: A remote erase this phone cannot read keeps the reminders opt-in and first-seen files until a good read
evidence: ReminderScheduler ends reminders on a moved erase epoch (a good read) or a moved store erase count (ReminderEvent.erased, PR 1666). The count moves only on this phone's own erase: RecordStore.swift:316 (erasePhone) and :336 (showErased), and showErased is called only from CloudSync.swift:200, inside this phone's erase(). An erase made on another device arrives as a record with a higher epoch; if this phone cannot read it, reminders-opt-in and reminders-first-seen stay until a good read. Pending notifications are still removed on each refresh, since a failed read schedules none. Fix: move the erase count on news of a remote erase, even undrawn. Needs a design note first.
